## 10 · Scheduled Multi-Keyword Scan → Dedupe → Airtable

**What it does:** On a schedule, scans for several keywords/brands in one run, flattens the results, removes anything already seen (deduped across runs), and writes new mentions to Airtable.

**Setup**
1. **Every Few Hours** → set cadence.
2. **Keywords** → edit the list in the Code node.
3. **Scan Keyword** → MentionFox connection token; narrow *Sources* to control spend.
4. **Save New to Airtable** → pick Base + Table.

**Credentials & key**
- Scan → **MentionFox connection token** (mentionfox.com/connect).
- (Paid FoxAPIs nodes elsewhere use your **FoxAPIs API key** from **foxapis.com** — never a MentionFox connection token.)

**Credit cost per run:** scan **3 cr per source × number of keywords**. e.g. 3 keywords × 4 sources = 36 cr/run. Fewer sources / keywords = lower spend.

Pricing: https://mentionfox.com/pricing

nodes.name: Keywords
nodes.notes: One item per keyword. The Scan node runs once per item.

nodes.name: Scan Keyword
nodes.notes: Calls scan_for_mentions per keyword. 3 cr per source. MentionFox connection token.

nodes.name: Flatten Mentions
nodes.notes: Merges all keywords' results into a single mention stream.

nodes.name: Dedupe (across runs)
nodes.notes: Drops any mention seen in a previous run. Keeps the last 2000 URLs in static data.

nodes.name: Save New to Airtable
nodes.notes: Writes only the new, deduped mentions.
